title: Tooltip path
scenario: The pointer moving inside one tooltip-bearing control during the hover delay and while shown (the W1.6 path: 50 moves each), with the show delay passed on the frozen fixture clock. Proves G1, G2.
cppAllocations: not counted: this executable does not replace the allocation functions

phases.name: pending

phases.name: show
phases.description: the fixture clock passes the show delay: the tooltip shows at the last pointer origin

phases.name: shown
phases.description: the same 50 moves inside the Label while the tooltip is shown
